name: Hill giant calling out
about: A slow, enormous voice rolling across open hills and coming back off the far slopes.

name: Sleepy giant in the woods
about: A drowsy giant drawling slower and slower among the trees.

name: Ogre chef in a busy kitchen
about: A gravelly ogre barking orders over sizzling pans and clanging pots.

name: Ogre with a stuffy nose
about: A big blocked-up ogre honking every word through his nose.

name: Giant looking down at you
about: A towering voice coming from high above your head, out in the open air.

name: Two-headed ogre arguing
about: Two grumbling ogre heads, one in each ear, taking turns to talk.

name: One-eyed giant in a sea cave
about: A rumbling one-eyed giant in a huge sea cave while waves boom on the rocks.

name: Gentle giant by the fire
about: A warm, soft-hearted giant telling a story beside a crackling hearth.

name: Titan in the storm clouds
about: A colossal voice an octave under thunder, filling the whole sky.

name: Young giant, voice breaking
about: A huge teenage giant whose voice keeps cracking up and squeaking.

name: Troll under the bridge
about: A rough, gravelly troll growling from a stone arch over rushing water.

name: Mountain troll bellowing
about: A craggy troll roaring from a windy peak, its echoes rolling down the valley.

name: Old troll grandmother
about: A creaky, wobbling old troll muttering by her smoky fire.

name: Sneaky goblin up close
about: A nasal, scratchy goblin leaning right up to your left ear.

name: Crowd of haggling goblins
about: A whole market of squabbling goblins, every one of them you, at a noisy fair.

name: Goblin chief in his hall
about: A thick, sneering goblin boss holding court in a torch-lit stone hall.

name: Imp darting around your head
about: A tiny quivering imp zipping in circles around you on headphones.

name: Imp on your shoulder
about: A mischievous little imp half-whispering bad ideas right by your right ear.

name: Gremlin in the engine room
about: A crackly little gremlin chattering away among pounding machinery.

name: Gremlins chattering in the dark
about: A pack of giggling gremlins all talking over each other in a small room.

name: Hobgoblin in the cupboard
about: A creaky, grumpy hobgoblin complaining from inside a cramped cupboard.

name: Kobold deep in the mine
about: A small, quick mine spirit calling down a long dripping tunnel.

name: Demon of the pit
about: The classic demon: your words with two octaves underneath, a growl and a burning edge.

name: Hissing lesser demon
about: A small, spiteful demon whose rasping words come out half hiss.

name: Archdemon over the flames
about: A colossal ruler of demons, deep and distorted, in a vast hall of roaring fire.

name: Demon below the floorboards
about: A huge growling voice coming up muffled through the floor beneath you.

name: Ice demon in a blizzard
about: A cold, brittle demon whose words ring like ice while a snowstorm howls.

name: Fire demon in the bonfire
about: A demon speaking out of the flames themselves, its words crackling and roaring.

name: Chained demon in the dungeon
about: A creaking, chained demon groaning deep under a castle as its chains shift.

name: Demon whispering in your ear
about: A deep, breathy demon voice right at your ear, all air and menace.

name: Infernal herald
about: A clanging, metallic demon voice in three octaves, announcing doom in a great hall.

name: Demon lord on his throne
about: A smooth, regal, impossibly deep voice in a torch-lit throne hall.

name: Little demon spitting sparks
about: A small, dark, fizzing demon racing around your head.

name: Demon taking over your voice
about: You start out as yourself and sink, word by word, into a growling demon.

name: Groaning zombie
about: A slow, creaking, gargling zombie dragging every word out of a rotten throat.

name: Zombie horde in the wind
about: A whole shambling crowd of creaking zombies, all moaning your words out of step.

name: Hungry ghoul down the well
about: A thin, raw, hungry voice scraping up from the bottom of a stone well.

name: Mummy waking in the tomb
about: A dry, dusty, creaking breath of a voice, thousands of years old, under desert sand.

name: Rattling skeleton
about: A bony, hollow voice with nothing left but the loudest notes, its jaw clacking as it talks.

name: Lich in a frozen crypt
about: A skeletal sorcerer's voice whose echo sinks an octave into the cold.

name: Zombie at the window
about: A creaking zombie moaning through the glass while rain streams down it.

name: Revenant on the battlefield
about: A gritty, vengeful dead warrior whose shouts echo across a windswept field.

name: Choir of skeletons
about: Half a dozen hollow, bony voices chanting your words together in a stone chapel.

name: Drowned sailor risen
about: A waterlogged sailor back from the deep, gurgling words through a throat full of sea.

name: Werewolf in mid-change
about: A person turning into a wolf as they speak, the voice sinking into a snarl under the moon.

name: Snarling wolf beast
about: A raspy, snapping beast growling every word just off to your right in the night woods.

name: Bear-chested brute
about: A huge furry brute with a booming barrel chest and a low rumbling growl.

name: Bull-headed beast in the maze
about: A snorting bull-headed giant whose voice bounces down endless stone corridors.

name: Wild man of the woods
about: A big hairy forest giant calling from somewhere far off among the swaying trees.

name: Yeti in the snowstorm
about: A shaggy snow beast roaring across a frozen pass, its echo lost in the blizzard.

name: Gargoyle on the cathedral roof
about: A stony, scraping voice ringing down from a carved beast high above you.

name: Hellhound at the gate
about: A savage fire-breathing hound, all snarl and fizz, with flames roaring behind it.

name: Shapeshifter changing shape
about: A voice that never settles, its pitch and size bending and melting as it talks.

name: Three-headed guard dog
about: Three snarling heads at once, left, middle and right, each a different size.

name: Vampire, cold and close
about: A smooth, chilly voice leaning in close, with a vast dark hall behind it.

name: Old count in his castle
about: A deep, velvety aristocrat welcoming you into a huge stone hall as a tall clock ticks.

name: Ancient vampire awakening
about: A dusty, creaking voice that has not spoken in centuries, slowly finding its words.

name: Vampire bride hissing
about: A pale, airy voice doubled and drifting, hissing softly in a long dark corridor.

name: Vampire inside the coffin
about: A low voice shut inside a wooden box, muffled and boxy, demanding to be let out.

name: Vampire turning into bats
about: A voice that breaks apart into a flapping, squeaking cloud of bats.

name: Vampire asking to come in
about: A soft, polite voice outside your window on a windy night, asking to be let in.

name: Hypnotic vampire voice
about: A flattened, swaying, multiplied voice that drifts slowly from ear to ear.

name: Dragon breathing fire
about: An enormous rumbling dragon in its cave, with fire roaring and crackling around it.

name: Baby dragon learning to roar
about: A small, scratchy dragon trying very hard to sound fierce by a little fire.

name: Ice dragon on the glacier
about: A vast frosty dragon whose voice glints like ice and sinks down into its own echo.

name: Dragon dozing on its gold
about: A drowsy dragon mumbling in its treasure cave, its giant heart slowly thumping.

name: Sea serpent rising
about: A long hissing serpent lifting its head out of rolling waves to speak.

name: Wyvern screeching past
about: A shrieking winged beast swooping over your head from left to right, twice.

name: Dragon circling overhead
about: A huge dragon wheeling slowly around and above you in the open sky.

name: Ancient dragon behind the falls
about: A slow, wise, impossibly old dragon speaking from a vast hall behind a waterfall.

name: Two-headed dragon
about: Two dragon heads speaking together, a deeper one on the left and a sharper one on the right.

name: Dragon hatchlings squabbling
about: A nest of scratchy little dragons all squawking your words at once in a cave.

name: Swamp beast rising from the mud
about: A bubbling, muddy monster heaving up out of a warm swamp at night.

name: Bog monster gargling
about: A slimy thing talking through a mouthful of pond water by a chorus of frogs.

name: Kraken from the deep
about: A colossal sea monster booming up from the black water far below the waves.

name: Fish-headed lagoon dweller
about: A wet, gulping amphibian voice, slightly out of tune, among tropical night frogs.

name: Lake monster in the fog
about: Something huge calling from far out across foggy water as a foghorn moans.

name: Sewer mutant
about: A croaking, crunchy mutant echoing up the drainpipes as water pours past.

name: Tentacled thing in the well
about: A deep, wavering, gurgling voice welling up from the water at the bottom of a well.

name: Crab king clicking
about: A hard-shelled crustacean lord clicking and clacking every word on the rocks.

name: Giant swamp toad
about: A monstrous croaking toad booming from the reeds while the frogs sing.

name: Oozing slime monster
about: A gooey blob of a voice that slides, swirls and drips as it speaks.

name: Insect queen in the hive
about: A regal buzzing queen with her many voices around her, deep inside a humming hive.

name: Hive mind speaking as one
about: Dozens of tight, buzzing copies of you saying every word in perfect step.

name: Giant spider above you
about: A thin, hissing, ticking voice from a huge spider hanging in its web over your head.

name: Praying mantis knight
about: A thin, clicking insect warrior whose words knock like hollow wooden sticks.

name: Voice of the locust swarm
about: Your words broken into a crackling cloud of tiny wings over a hot buzzing field.

name: Wasp warrior zipping by
about: A buzzing, angry wasp soldier darting past your ears again and again.

name: Armoured beetle grinding
about: A big, hard-shelled beetle whose words scrape and click like plates of armour.

name: Ant colony in the walls
about: Dozens of tiny voices chattering your words from somewhere inside the wall.

name: Giant moth at the lamp
about: A soft, fluttering, papery voice beating around you on a summer night.

name: Desert scorpion beast
about: A dry, ticking, hissing creature talking low across the hot desert wind.

name: Stone golem grinding awake
about: A slow, grinding, resonant voice of living rock, rumbling into life.

name: Angry boulder
about: A crunchy, boomy lump of rock shouting across a canyon.

name: Earthquake beneath your feet
about: A shaking, rumbling voice from deep under the ground below you.

name: Lava monster bubbling
about: A molten, gritty voice popping and bubbling like boiling rock.

name: Bronze statue in the square
about: A metal statue suddenly speaking, its bronze body ringing beside a splashing fountain.

name: Clockwork ogre ticking
about: A huge wind-up ogre whose words grind out in jerky steps of gears and springs.

name: Cave creature behind you
about: Something breathy and creaking whispering from the dark behind you in a dripping cave.

name: Giant worm under the dunes
about: A colossal muffled rumble rising up through the sand beneath you as the wind hisses.
